per_case.review_profile_detail: Rejected four unsupported positive document and image capability assertions on arrival and opening-only activities, and corrected one step input from document evidence.
Corrected three explicit capability signals the extraction had left unknown, rejected one incorrect forward dependency and resolved the resulting blocking conflict.
Made no corrections and no rejections. The extraction missed no supported signal and produced no incorrect structure.

findings.title: Process reconstruction is the most consistently reliable behaviour
findings.detail: All sixteen documented activities across three industries were reconstructed in source order with resolved evidence, and no unsupported activity was added in any case. On PORT-003, a high-profile case with high recorded memorisation risk, the extraction did not reconstruct the widely reported email-drafting or CRM steps that were absent from the anonymised input.

findings.title: The deterministic decision engine was never exercised beyond one gate by a real case
findings.detail: All sixteen activities returned INVESTIGATE_FURTHER, and every one of them stopped at the technical-fit gate on unknown ai_capability_fit. The business-value and risk-and-autonomy gates were never evaluated on a portfolio case and no priority score was ever produced. Policy logic is exercised by unit tests, but no real portfolio case reached the policy thresholds or scoring bands. The evaluation validates gate ordering and implementation behaviour, not whether policy judgements are defensible on real processes.
findings.scope_correction: An earlier revision of this summary stated that no threshold, weight or scoring band in decision_policy.v0.2 was ever tested. That was inaccurate: tests/unit exercises all four recommendation modes, the gate sequence and the scoring bands with synthetic inputs. The accurate limitation is about construct validity on real processes, not about absent test coverage.
findings.root_cause: Public BEFORE evidence describes what an organisation did, not the operational criterion values the policy consumes. Press releases and vendor case studies do not report repetition, predictability, data readiness, error consequence or quantified value, so those criteria are structurally unavailable in this evidence class.

findings.title: Human review demonstrated three distinct and complementary contribution profiles
findings.detail: PORT-001 suppressed four unsupported positive capability assertions. PORT-002 recovered three supported signals the extraction had missed and rejected one incorrect dependency. PORT-003 correctly changed nothing. Across the portfolio, review caught extraction false positives, extraction false negatives, and correctly abstained when the extraction was sound. This is the clearest evidence that the Phase 4 boundary is functional rather than ceremonial.

findings.title: Human-oversight and control design was never reconstructed
findings.detail: Every case documented an AFTER control boundary: PORT-001 confidence thresholds and retained organisational control, PORT-002 the retained human-service boundary, PORT-003 adviser verification and discretion. None was identified from BEFORE evidence. Two were classified NO_DOCUMENTED_ALIGNMENT and one PARTIAL_ALIGNMENT. Governance design appears to be systematically absent from public BEFORE descriptions.

findings.title: Half the capability taxonomy was never exercised, and one needed capability is unrepresentable
findings.detail: Five of ten capabilities were never produced across sixteen activities. Separately, PORT-003 established that the taxonomy has no speech, audio or transcription signal, so the defining capability of that intervention could not have been expressed regardless of evidence quality. This is a product expressiveness finding. The taxonomy is frozen and was not modified during the evaluation.

findings.title: Zero contradictions, but the result is weaker than it appears
findings.detail: No theme in any case was classified CONTRADICTION. That is a real absence of false negatives, but it is substantially a consequence of finding XC-2: a system that always answers INVESTIGATE_FURTHER cannot contradict a later deployment. The absence of contradictions should not be read as decision accuracy.

findings.title: No negative case was evaluated, so specificity is unmeasured
findings.detail: All three cases are organisations that did adopt AI and published about it. The portfolio contains no case where AI was considered and rejected, or deployed and withdrawn. There is therefore no measurement of whether the product would decline to identify an opportunity where none existed, and no true-negative evidence of any kind.

operator_scripts_preserved.note: PORT-001 and PORT-002 operator scripts were not committed and are unrecoverable. Their runs remain hash-verifiable through frozen artefacts but are not re-executable. PORT-003 committed its operator scripts.

overall_limitations: Three self-selected cases, all published adoption success stories.
Every AFTER source is organisation-authored or relies materially on company sources; no independent accuracy, client-impact or risk evaluation was found for any intervention.
Reported outcome figures are non-comparable across and within cases and were never merged.
The reviewing research agent was not blind to public AFTER evidence in any case.
Model-memorisation contamination cannot be excluded, and is recorded as high for PORT-003.
The deterministic decision policy remains provisional; per XC-2 its logic is unit-tested, but its judgements were never validated against a real process by this exercise.
No statistical, causal or cross-industry generalisation is supported by three cases.
honest_headline: The product reliably reconstructs documented processes from thin public evidence, identifies a partially overlapping subset of the capability areas organisations later deployed, and consistently refuses to recommend adoption when the evidence does not support one. Its deterministic recommendation layer, which is the product's central claim, was not meaningfully exercised by this evaluation.
